    Opposite primitive-projective presentations #

    Regular Hom-duality converts a complete primitive-projective presentation of a finite-dimensional algebra into one for the opposite algebra. On the selected projective categories it is an anti-equivalence preserving the radical and its square. Hence it reverses ordinary-quiver arrows and converts the outgoing degree bound for biserial presentations into the corresponding incoming bound.
